title: Diagnose Codex CLI incomplete local package error
description: Identify why invoking codex reports that the CLI has no complete local package and provide the corrective action.
notes:
Diagnosed codex 0.159.2 startup: PATH resolves to llm-agents.nix's source-built binary at /etc/profiles/per-user/ct/bin/codex. That derivation installs only bin/{codex,codex-code-mode-host,logs_client} and completions. New daemon startup requires a packaged layout rooted by codex-package.json plus bin/codex, bin/codex-code-mode-host, and codex-path/rg. No codex-package.json means InstallContext.package_layout=None and startup emits the exact error. codex --no-daemon works.
Verified Homebrew cask codex 0.159.2 is not installed. Its URL is the official complete codex-package-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz, unlike the Nix source build. Repo currently installs llmAgents.codex unconditionally in nix/features/common.nix:206, so Darwin resolves the incomplete Nix package first. Recommended immediate workaround: --no-daemon. Durable Darwin fix: install Homebrew cask codex and remove/condition llmAgents.codex to non-Darwin.
